items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Mr. Pila or Cops. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I know, tous les jours dimanche, that's creole.

ctx.x: Oui, you can you sing a little about that? Don't say Kalinda, Bujun, Bujun. Mr. Pila or Cops. I'm going to hear something. I'm going to hear something.

I know, tous les jours dimanche, that's creole. Tous les jours dimanche, it's coming sometime. Tous les jours, c'est fait. Tous les jours, t'embouillaka yavaka. Ça n'a fait pour ça. As much as I know, I can't remember. Just cannot remember.
